idea-plugin.name: Always Select Opened File
idea-plugin.description:
Automatically enables the Project View option Always Select Opened File (formerly Autoscroll from Source) for every project when it is opened, so the file you are editing is always selected and revealed in the project tree.

If you switch the option off from the Project View menu, it is turned back on the next time you open that project.

Works on all IntelliJ-based IDEs, using public IntelliJ Platform APIs only.
idea-plugin.change-notes:

  • Compatible with all IntelliJ-based IDEs, from 2023.1 onwards
